evidence: Touches depends package handling and Guix build configuration for cross-architecture builds.
rationale: Fixes Guix cross-architecture build failures and prevents depends from building against stale tarballs from another checkout. In the build category, release integrity and reproducible Guix builds matter most; commit 76b0e368ce notes that sharing SOURCES_PATH across checkouts 'reliably' caused builds from wrong sources in guix-build, making this a critical fix for maintenance release 32.2.
